title:
What percentage of carcinogenic-type molecules does not contain fluorine?
B
question:
What percentage of carcinogenic-type molecules does not contain fluorine?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; contain fluorine refers to element = 'f'; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(element = 'f') * 100, COUNT(molecule_id)) where label = '+'; Should consider the distinct atoms when counting;

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  CAST(100.0 * (COUNT(DISTINCT m.XCL_010) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'f' THEN m.XCL_010 END)) AS REAL)
  / COUNT(DISTINCT m.XCL_010)
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN atom a ON a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+';
